title: Conservation corps member
priority_audience: corps programmes; land agencies hiring corps alumni; training officers
federal_series_crosswalk: n/a (non-federal-employee programme; feeds 0462|0404|0458|0455 via corps hiring authorities)
state_class_examples: TX Fish and Wildlife Technician I (destination)
rationale: Entry of corridor COR-1; the formation substrate for field craft; AmeriCorps cuts largely reinstated but settlement covers FY2026 only [E: V1], so supply is fragile; pre-registered pathway corps alum to agency technician (ADR-0006 s.7).

title: Field resource technician
priority_audience: federal HR (0400 kit); state technician ladders; corps alumni
state_class_examples: TX Fish and Wildlife Technician I|NY Fish and Wildlife Technician 2|WA Natural Resource Specialist 1
rationale: Largest field entry role; formation tasks (survey, sampling, identification) are where AI compression threatens learning (ADR-0026); federal-to-state technician move pre-registered.

title: Monitoring and data technician
priority_audience: state water-quality and air monitoring units; federal science centres; consulting labs
state_class_examples: MN Pollution Control Technician|CA Environmental Scientist (Laboratory, Department of Water Resources)
rationale: Bridges FC field measurement and DC data quality (FC-C01, FC-C24, DC-CAND-04); sensor networks shift tasks from collection to verification.

title: Geospatial and remote sensing analyst
priority_audience: federal and state GIS units; consulting; NGOs
state_class_examples: WA Natural Resource Scientist 2 (geospatial assignments)
rationale: DC-heavy end of COR-1; EO foundation models change the method layer (L4) not the role core (ADR-0003 T-6).

title: Ground-truth and validation steward
priority_audience: EO and AI programme owners; monitoring programmes; carbon MRV
state_class_examples: none found in sample
rationale: FS emerging role composed from FS-C04, FC-C02, FC-C31 and DC-CAND-13; counter-signal: validation absorbed into vendor services with no agency field calibration; pre-registered pathway technician to ground-truth steward.

title: Wildland fire operations (crew to supervisor)
priority_audience: federal and state fire agencies; contract crews; training centres
state_class_examples: WA Natural Resource Specialist 6 (land, crews and fire in one class)
rationale: Entry of COR-2; NWCG position qualifications are Credential gates, not levels (T-8); Jan 2027 standards are USWFS-USFS, NWCG not party [E: V1].

title: Fuels and prescribed fire specialist
priority_audience: federal and state fire programmes; county wildfire planning; land trusts
state_class_examples: none found in sample (state fuels work sits in forester and NR specialist classes)
rationale: Prescribed fire (v1 4.3.2 successor) and smoke management (DB-C15); FS stress test suggests protect; Tribal cultural fire partnership content held (TN-C06); pre-registered pathway fire to county wildfire planner.

title: Fire intelligence analyst (continuous operations)
priority_audience: federal fire agencies; state fire agencies; WFIC horizon channel
state_class_examples: none found in sample
rationale: Resolves the WFIC-1 gate (ADR-0020): no F16, no WFIC-2/3; composed from FS-C05, v1 4.3.4, DC-CAND-12; counter-signal: function stays inside FBAN/LTAN incident positions with no year-round staffing.

title: Restoration and land stewardship project lead
priority_audience: land agencies; watershed councils; land trusts; consulting
state_class_examples: TX Natural Resources Specialist III|NY Environmental Program Specialist 2 (Natural Resources)
rationale: Entry of COR-3; v1 4.2.1 successor with process-based restoration; crosses FC (implementation), DC (monitoring design) and SC (agreements, permits).

title: Environmental review specialist
priority_audience: federal NEPA units; state little-NEPA units (CEQA, MEPA, SEPA); DOT environmental offices; consultants
state_class_examples: CA Environmental Scientist (Caltrans, CEQA/NEPA)|MN Pollution Control Specialist Principal (Environmental Review Unit Supervisor)
rationale: Core of permitting reform; written to agency procedures after CEQ regulation removal (effective Jan 8 2026) and Seven County [E: V2]; pre-registered pathway federal NEPA coordinator to state review.

title: Environmental permit writer
priority_audience: state permitting programmes (NPDES, air, waste, wetlands); delegated programmes
state_class_examples: PA Environmental Engineering Specialist (NPDES permit writer)|MI Environmental Quality Analyst 9-P11/12 (permits)|TX Environmental Protection Specialist III
rationale: Most of state regulatory work (SL); core SL-C02 with module enactments; mirror of applicant strategy (SC-C01) and facility compliance (R37); pre-registered pathway state water-quality specialist to permit writer.

title: Environmental compliance inspector
priority_audience: state and local inspection programmes; EPA regions
state_class_examples: TX Environmental Protection Specialist I|PA Environmental Protection Specialist (inspections)|FL Environmental Specialist II
rationale: Inspection is the most-mapped state function [E: SL]; core SL-C03 with FC field anchors; regulator <-> facility compliance mobility test with R37.

title: Natural resource and environmental programme manager
priority_audience: agency programme managers; district rangers; state division managers
state_class_examples: MN Pollution Control Strategic Manager|NY Environmental Program Specialist 4|CA Senior Environmental Scientist (Supervisor)
rationale: Corridor end-point where SC, budgeting (SC-C10), workforce planning (FH-C14) and formation of others (TX-D) concentrate.

title: Forester
priority_audience: federal and state forestry; certification-scheme forestry; consulting
state_class_examples: NY Forester 1
rationale: FH priority series; flagship Forester PD prototype regenerated from data (ADR-0027); SAF accreditation crosswalk (X6, paraphrased).

title: Wildlife biologist
priority_audience: state fish and wildlife agencies; FWS; consulting
state_class_examples: TX Natural Resources Specialist I
rationale: FH and SL priority; pre-registered pathway wildlife graduate to consulting biologist.

title: Fisheries and aquatic biologist
priority_audience: state fish and wildlife agencies; FWS/NOAA; Tribal fisheries programmes (held)
state_class_examples: TX Natural Resources Specialist I-IV (Fisheries Management Biologist)
rationale: FH and SL priority; MOD-12 home; Tribal fisheries enactments held (ADR-0007).

title: Hydrologist
priority_audience: state water agencies; USGS; utilities; consulting
state_class_examples: TX Hydrologist I|TX Hydrologist IV
rationale: FH priority series; state hydrologists oversee local water systems (TX Hydrologist IV note).

title: Rangeland management specialist
priority_audience: BLM and USFS range programmes; state trust lands
state_class_examples: none found in sample
rationale: Grazing authorization (IA-CC-01) is one of IA public-lands gap functions; resource-manager authority position.

title: Soil conservationist
priority_audience: NRCS; conservation districts; state agriculture agencies
state_class_examples: none found in sample
rationale: FH priority series; needs FH-C03 (private-landowner conservation planning), drafted early in MOD-14.

title: Ecologist
priority_audience: federal science and land agencies; state heritage programmes; consulting
state_class_examples: WA Natural Resource Scientist 3
rationale: Covers ecological assessment and transformation planning (v1 1.7.x) with research variants.

title: Park ranger (visitor and resource management)
priority_audience: NPS; state parks; county parks
state_class_examples: TX Park Ranger I|TX Park/Historic Site Superintendent I
rationale: MOD-15 home; sworn law-enforcement rangers are a separate variant (credential gate), not a level.

title: Environmental engineer
priority_audience: state permitting and drinking-water programmes; utilities; consulting
state_class_examples: MI Environmental Engineer 9-P11 / Licensed 12|NY Assistant Engineer (Environmental) / Professional Engineer 2 (Environmental)|PA Environmental Engineering Specialist
rationale: Separate role because PE licensure changes which tasks may be performed (ADR-0006 rule 3a); WI 2017 Act 111 restricts "engineer" in titles (title-neutral function).

title: Enforcement case manager
priority_audience: state enforcement units; EPA regions; AG offices
state_class_examples: MI Environmental Quality Analyst 9-P11/12 (Enforcement Analyst)|PA Environmental Protection Specialist (enforcement)|MN Pollution Control Specialist Principal (Special Materials Compliance and Enforcement Unit Supervisor)
rationale: SL-C04 case arc from referral to settlement or litigation; sworn conservation police are a separate credential-gated variant (NY Environmental Conservation Police Officer).

title: Drinking water programme analyst
priority_audience: state primacy agencies; EPA regions
state_class_examples: MI Environmental Quality Analyst 9-P11 (Lead and Copper Compliance Analyst)
rationale: SDWA primacy work had no v1 competency [E: SL]; MOD-01 home (SL-C06); delegated-programme oversight SC-C14.

title: Water and wastewater treatment operator
priority_audience: municipal utilities; private operators; federal facilities (WG)
state_class_examples: TX Natural Resources Specialist I (knowledge list includes water treatment operations)
rationale: Separate role because operator certification in responsible charge defines legal scope (ADR-0006 rule 3a); largest uncovered v1 workforce [E: DB-003]; state certification boards as Credential issuers.

title: Environmental health specialist
priority_audience: county and city health departments; state EH programmes
state_class_examples: TX Sanitarian I|FL Sanitation and Safety Specialist|FL Environmental Technician (mosquito control, Polk County)|CA Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist; CEHS registration for some positions)
rationale: Separate role because REHS/CEHS registration defines scope (rule 3a); MOD-06 home; v1 had no EH inspection competency [E: SL].

title: Remediation project manager
priority_audience: state cleanup programmes; EPA Superfund; DoD/DOE; consulting
state_class_examples: PA Environmental Protection Specialist (Superfund/hazardous-site contractor oversight)|MI Environmental Quality Analyst 9-P11 (MUSTA)
rationale: MOD-04 home (DB-C19, DB-C20); LSP-type licensed opinions recorded as sign-off authority.

title: Air quality specialist
priority_audience: state and local air agencies and districts; EPA regions; consulting
state_class_examples: TX Environmental Protection Specialist V (air and noise modelling)
rationale: Splits v1 6.7.5 into a regulatory programme (permitting, SIP planning, monitoring, enforcement) homed in MOD-03 (DB, SL, SC verdicts).

title: Solid waste and materials management specialist
priority_audience: state waste programmes; county and city solid waste; EPR programmes
state_class_examples: CA Assistant / Associate Environmental Services Specialist (City of San Jose, municipal)
rationale: MOD-04 home (DB-C16, DB-C17, SL-C14); v1 framed waste as corporate circular-economy strategy (DB verdict).

title: Hazard mitigation and floodplain manager
priority_audience: county and city floodplain administrators; state hazard mitigation offices; FEMA
state_class_examples: none found in sample
rationale: MOD-09 home (DB-C40, DB-C43); CFM as Credential; EHP review for recovery (DB-C41).

title: AI-assisted environmental review lead
priority_audience: federal and state review units adopting AI tools
state_class_examples: none found in sample
rationale: FS emerging role; composed from SL-C08, SC-C02, DC-CAND-13 (SC enactment) and DC-CAND-16; counter-signal: AI review tools retired or confined to pilots (e.g. DOI PCAT retired [E: DC]); shown only in the what's-coming view.

title: Environmental AI assurance officer
priority_audience: agency CAIO offices; consulting QA; independent verifiers
state_class_examples: none found in sample
rationale: Composed from DC-CAND-15, DC-CAND-19, DC-CAND-14; M-25-21 high-impact AI practices create the duty [E: DC]; counter-signal: assurance remains a collateral duty with no positions; review +12 months.

title: Permitting technology product owner
priority_audience: permitting modernization offices; state digital services
state_class_examples: none found in sample
rationale: Composed from FS-C09, DC-CAND-20, SC-C01; CEQ data standard v1.2 and permitting technology programmes [E: V2]; counter-signal: products bought as turnkey vendor services.

title: Intergovernmental stewardship agreement manager
priority_audience: GNA and shared-stewardship programmes; state forestry; NGO partners
state_class_examples: none found in sample
rationale: Composed from SC-C08, v1 3.1.4, FH-C02; GNA expanding, co-stewardship uncertain (JSO 3403 status unconfirmed [E: V2]); Tribal agreement content (TN-C04) held.

title: Knowledge continuity lead
priority_audience: agencies facing retirement and RIF losses; training officers
state_class_examples: none found in sample
rationale: Composed from FH-C07, IO-C01, v1 7.2.2 (TX-D); EPA departures had a 30.3-year median service [E: V1]; counter-signal: no dedicated positions after attrition stabilizes.

title: GHG and nature data controller
priority_audience: corporate sustainability and finance functions; verifiers
state_class_examples: none found in sample
rationale: Composed from PS-C09, SC-C15, PS-C22; SB 253 first reports Nov 10 2026 [E: V2]; counter-signal: disclosure scope cuts (EU Omnibus I; the SEC climate rule never took effect) reduce demand.

title: Facility environmental compliance specialist
priority_audience: regulated facilities; utilities; DoD/DOE installations
state_class_examples: PA Environmental Protection Compliance Specialist (cross-media; federal-title equivalency in MQ)
rationale: Regulated-party mirror of R12 to test regulator <-> regulated mobility (DB-C26, SC-C15, PS-C18); pre-registered pathway regulator <-> facility compliance.
